newsitem.title: ESTONIA: CONSTRUCTION COMPANY FCM TO ISSUE SHARES-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: CONSTRUCTION COMPANY FCM TO ISSUE SHARES-REPORT.

text.p: Estonian construction company FCM will in the summer issue new shares worth 2.5 million kroons to rise its share capital to 12.5 million kroons, Aripaev newspaper said on Wednesday.
FCM will seek listing on the secondary list of the Tallinn bourse after the share issue, chairman Tiit Kuuli was quoted as saying.
The company will use the resources from the issue to improve its services and expand into foreign markets, he added.
The share issue will be handled by Hansa Investments.

FCM had net turnover of 159 million kroons and profit of seven million kroons in 1996. It estimates a net turnover of 200 million kroons and profit of nine million kroons in 1997, the newspaper added.
